summary: Enhance your leadership skills with our Leading Through Change: Adaptation and Resilience Course. Learn how to navigate challenges and drive success.
lede: Leading through change focuses on practical methods for managers and change-support professionals guiding teams through operational transitions. Learners practice assessing readiness and role impacts, using ADKAR to plan adoption, and preparing communication and resistance responses. They also develop team resilience actions and adoption measures to track progress and report change outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead or support change in day-to-day operations and need practical tools for adoption, resilience, and communication. Change Managers who coordinate adoption plans and resistance responses. Project Managers who deliver transition milestones across affected teams. Operations Managers who reset workflows during process or system change. HR Business Partners who support people impacts and readiness. Organization Development Specialists who design change enablement interventions. Team Leaders who maintain performance through transition pressure. Transformation Office Analysts who track change impacts and adoption metrics. Internal Communications Managers who shape change messages and cadence. Line Managers who handle team concerns and local implementation issues. Learning and Development Specialists who build resilience capability workshops.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: foundation knowledge of team leadership, project coordination, or operational management; no coding required. You should be comfortable discussing current team workflows, reporting lines, and basic performance indicators. The course uses practical templates and scenario-based exercises, so bringing a laptop is recommended for completing the change impact map, stakeholder readiness matrix, and communication plan. This course teaches adaptation and resilience through structured leadership exercises so you can apply the tools in real transition settings.
